If you've done outbound for a while, you know what most SDR roles actually look like: a number on a board, a script to follow, and meetings that get booked whether they're ready or not. We built this role differently.
Our SDRs spend 15 to 30 minutes on a qualifying call. Not to pitch, but to actually understand what's broken in a prospect's business and whether it's worth an AE's time. We call it a pain chain: symptom, root cause, business cost. And: No chain, no meeting; the AE will send it back for further qualification. It keeps the quality honest and it means the work you do actually matters downstream. If you're ready to trade volume for something with more substance, it's worth a conversation.
🎯 What you’ll own
Your accounts are mid-market and enterprise (150-5,000 employees). You run the full qualification process before anything reaches an AE, which in practice looks like this:
Qualification calls that go long enough to build a real case, not just confirm that someone picked up
Re-engagement on accounts that have been approached before, with a genuine plan for how to get in differently
Follow-up calls with yourself when a first conversation doesn't go deep enough, rather than booking something that isn't ready
Finding your own contacts when the data isn't clean, because it often isn't
Keeping HubSpot honest so your pipeline reflects reality
Working closely enough with your AE that what you hand off actually lands

You've done B2B outbound before and you have a real opinion on what makes a qualification call worth something. That's the baseline.
1-2 years of outbound sales or SDR experience in B2B
You've worked accounts with no clean data, navigated gatekeepers, and made multi-touch sequences actually work
You think about pipeline quality, not just volume, and you can explain the difference to someone who disagrees
Fluent German, working English

🤩 What's different here
The qualification bar here is genuinely high. A meeting without a clear pain chain doesn't move forward, and you're expected to know that before it reaches the AE. There's no hiding behind dial counts or activity metrics when the pipeline tells a different story.
The accounts you'll work aren't easy. No clean contact data, gatekeepers who've heard every opener, prospects who need a few different approaches before they pick up. The job isn't to call more. It's to find the angle that works, and to keep looking until you do.
When it clicks, you feel it. Your pipeline moves, your meetings convert, and the AE comes back wanting more. People here have moved to AE in around 24 months. That track is real, and it starts with the quality of what you build in this role.

In dieser vielseitigen Rolle bist du nahe am Verkauf, nahe an unseren Kundinnen und Kunden und ein wichtiger Dreh- und Angelpunkt im täglichen Geschäft. Du unterstützt unsere Versicherungs- und Vorsorgeberatenden aktiv und trägst mit deinem Engagement dazu bei, dass Kundenanliegen rasch verstanden und überzeugend gelöst werden.
## Das bewirkst du bei uns ##
Du bist mittendrin im Verkaufsgeschehen und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Versicherungs- und Vorsorgeberatenden optimal unterstützt werden.
Mit deinem Organisationstalent erstellst du Offerten, verarbeitest Anträge und koordinierst Termine über alle Versicherungsbranchen hinweg. Gleichzeitig bringst du dein verkäuferisches Flair aktiv ein: Du erkennst Kundenbedürfnisse, denkst mit und trägst dazu bei, dass aus Kontakten überzeugende Lösungen entstehen.
Ob am Telefon, am Empfang auf der Generalagentur oder im Austausch mit internen und externen Anspruchsgruppen: Du begegnest Menschen offen, dienstleistungsorientiert und mit Freude. About Alta Ares
Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.
Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.
Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.
Role & Mission
This VIE is Alta Ares' commercial entry point in Germany — the largest defence market in Europe and one undergoing the most significant defence industrial expansion since reunification. Based in Munich, at the heart of Germany's defence industrial ecosystem (Rheinmetall, Hensoldt, KNDS, ESG, MTU), you will support and drive Alta Ares' early-stage commercial development with German primes and institutional contacts.
You will map the ecosystem, build first-contact relationships, and support the Account Manager Germany in converting opportunities into pipeline. Germany's Zeitenwende is real, budgets are moving fast, and the demand for AI and C-UAS capabilities is accelerating. You will be on the ground at the right moment.
1. Market Mapping & Opportunity Identification
Map Germany's defence industrial landscape: primes, systems integrators, procurement bodies (BAAINBw, Cyber Innovation Hub der Bundeswehr), and innovation initiatives ( dtec.bw , IDEaS-equivalent)
Identify partnership and integration opportunities aligned with Alta Ares' product suite: ISR, C-UAS, AI autonomy
Track German defence policy, Bundeswehr procurement priorities, and Zeitenwende investment programmes
Produce regular market intelligence reports for the Account Manager Germany and Paris leadership team
2. Relationship Building & Business Development
Initiate and develop first-contact relationships with BD, engineering, and procurement teams at target accounts: Rheinmetall, Hensoldt, KNDS, Diehl, ESG, BWI, and equivalent
Support the preparation of partner-facing materials, capability presentations, and meeting briefings
Qualify opportunities and escalate concrete prospects to the Account Manager Germany
Represent Alta Ares at key German defence events: DSEI, ILA Berlin, Eurosatory, and industry forums in Munich and Berlin
3. Germany–Paris Coordination
Serve as the operational bridge between Munich and Alta Ares HQ in Paris
Coordinate logistics for partner visits, demos, and leadership trips to Germany
Ensure smooth communication across time zones and cultural contexts — translating not just language but business culture
Candidate Profile
0–3 years of experience — open to recent graduates and early-career profiles
Background in business development, international relations, political science, engineering, or a related field
Prior exposure to Germany (studies, internship, or work experience) is a strong plus
German fluency — mandatory : your accounts are German industrial companies and relationships are built in German
English fluency — mandatory
French is a meaningful plus — daily interaction with Paris HQ
Genuine interest in defence technology, European security, and Germany's defence industrial ecosystem
Organised, proactive, and comfortable building relationships from scratch in a new market
Culturally agile: equally at ease in a formal German industrial setting and a fast-moving French startup
VIE Eligibility: French or EU nationality — mandatory. Aged 18 to 28 at mission start. No prior VIE with the same company.
